{'translation': "Apple's iPhone Pro model next year is expected to feature an all-new, all-glass design, coinciding with the iPhone's 20th anniversary. Today, a new leak details Apple's progress on this innovative model."}

{'translation': "Here is the latest news regarding Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design"}

{'translation': 'Apple is only weeks away from unveiling its first foldable, the iPhone Ultra. But next year will bring another unique, all-new iPhone design.'}

{'translation': "Apple is reportedly preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro model. The new device is said to feature a larger display with a quad-curved screen, with glass wrapping around the edges of the device for a visually zero-bezel effect."}

{'translation': 'Today on Weibo, leaker "Fixed Focus Digital" updated Apple\'s progress on achieving this unique look in a new post.'}

{'translation': 'He said Apple is using the same glass assembly process used for the iPhone Air, but with modifications, using more rounded material.'}

{'translation': 'The post also mentions that improvements have been made in two areas:'}

  • {'translation': 'Heat dissipation'}
  • {'translation': 'Device thickness'}

{'translation': "It's still too early to know just how thin Apple wants to go and what design materials will be used. However, so far the signs suggest this new device will take inspiration from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but won't prioritize thinness like those two."}

{'translation': 'Based on these latest reports, it seems we could get some of the design innovations of the iPhone Air and Ultra in a single model, while still delivering the performance and battery life Pro users expect.'}

{'translation': "Pro users don't want thinness to come first. But if Apple could deliver a similar experience in a slightly thinner model, combined with a unique all-glass look, it would be very appealing."}

{'translation': 'How interested are you in the rumored iPhone Pro 20 model next year? Let us know in the comments.'}
